============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v26.13.1 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |    736 ns | 1,358,132 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1211 ns | 825,786 | 341 | 1.64x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2159 ns | 463,090 | 341 | 2.93x slower |
| google-protobuf |   4210 ns | 237,533 | 341 | 5.72x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   3318 ns | 301,373 | 622 | 4.51x slower |
| JSON |   1493 ns | 669,788 | 791 | 2.03x slower |
